description: Have fun with your voice: pitch/speed shift, robot ring-modulation and echo on uploaded audio or mic recordings. Honest lite effects.

faqs.a: Lite means honest: the pitch slider changes speed too (like tape), robot is ring modulation, echo is a simple delay. No pro formant shifting is claimed.
Yes — hold the record button, allow the microphone, and your recording is processed locally.
faqs.q: Can I record with my mic?

faqs.a: WAV — always works, straight from your browser.

howto: Upload audio or record with your mic.
Set pitch/speed, toggle robot and echo.
Preview the result and download the WAV.
title: Voice Changer (Lite)
